author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete 

GO:0006116	NADH oxidation
GO:0070995	NADPH oxidation

The reason for obsoletion is that these terms represent reactants in oxidation and reduction reactions. 
See https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29050

Annotations are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm-72LgsOnezC8pzq4yAq9twDWQf910WjhwiLf4VK80/edit?gid=0#gid=0

There are 45 manual annotations to these terms: 

AgBase | 2 | DONE
-- | -- | --
BHF-UCL | 4 |  DONE
CAFA | 3 |  
EcoCyc | 1 |  
FlyBase | 4 |  
MGI | 2 |  
RGD | 8 |  
SGD | 12 |  
TAIR | 1 |  
UniProt | 8 | DONE

The proposed action is to just remove annotations, as these are redundant with MF annotations.

Thanks

Pascale
